A person named Sanjay Palanisamy, associated with the number 9000000215, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. A witness, Malathi Murugan, reachable on 9000000027, was mentioned in the complaint. Items referenced in the complaint: CCTV footage and a witness statement.
